question: What is the meaning of number of life cycles in relation to products and materials?
description: The number of life cycles refers to the repeated use and reuse of products and materials over time. It is an important aspect in life cycle management, as it influences decisions related to maintenance, refurbishment, or disassembly tasks. Understanding the number of life cycles helps in planning the future reuse options and assessing the environmental impacts associated with the product or material throughout its life cycle.
